name: XrayR v0.9.4
body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump golang.org/x/net from 0.26.0 to 0.27.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/656
* build(deps): bump github.com/hashicorp/go-retryablehttp from 0.7.5 to 0.7.7 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/657
* build(deps): bump github.com/gogf/gf/v2 from 2.6.4 to 2.7.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/632
* build(deps): bump github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azidentity from 1.5.1 to 1.6.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/658
* build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.64.0 to 1.64.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/659
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-resty/resty/v2 from 2.11.0 to 2.13.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/660
* Xray core1.8.20 & support splitHTTP by @wyx2685 in https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/pull/661


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XrayR-project/XrayR/compare/v0.9.3...v0.9.4
